abstract.simpara: This manual documents third-party PHP extensions: extensions that are maintained outside the php-src repository, and are typically distributed via PECL or PIE.
It complements the main PHP manual, which documents the language itself and the extensions bundled with PHP, available at &url.php.docs;.
